title: Attribution ambiguity probe plan
body:
Purpose:
Quick working plan for a focused probe suite that stresses attribution ambiguity and quote fidelity for domain RAG onboarding. Emphasis: detect subtle provenance errors (partial quotes, truncated context, incorrect source attribution) and incorrect refusals or overly eager hallucination. This is a lightweight evaluation artifact to iterate on with SEs and Solutions for first 3 model candidates.

Scope and intent:
- Domain focus: legal-ish contracts, financial filings (10-K style), and product support KBs. Each domain has distinct citation patterns and different tolerance for paraphrase.
- Tests cover: explicit quoting, paraphrase-with-source, multi-source synthesis, omission-of-source, and refusal/hedging behaviors when source missing.
- Not doing deep MRC QA or factual correctness beyond whether the model ties claims to a plausible source chunk.

High-level test matrix (draft):
- Retrieval config variations: top_k={1,3,5}, chunk_size={200,800}, overlap={0,128}
- Prompt template variants: short-instruction vs. citation-first vs. conservative-refusal
- Model variants: v1 (baseline), v1-quant (8-bit), v2 (fine-tuned refusal)

Sample prompts (canonicalized):
1) "From the documents above, provide a verbatim quote that supports the claim 'Company X reported a 12% YoY revenue increase' and cite the document id and paragraph number. If you cannot find a verbatim statement, say REFUSE with why."
2) "Summarize the company's guidance on recurring revenue and include the top-3 supporting excerpts with citations and starting offsets."
3) "Customer says: 'This contract says we get a 60-day termination notice' — indicate whether that exact phrasing exists; if not, provide closest matching excerpt and label similarity confidence (high/med/low)."

Expected behaviors / heuristics for scoring:
- Quote fidelity score (0..3): 3=exact match verbatim; 2=near-exact (minor punctuation/stopword diffs); 1=partial or stitching from multiple places; 0=invented text not present in any doc chunk.
- Attribution correctness (pass/fail): Pass if cited doc id contains the quoted excerpt within +/- 50 chars of reported offset.
- Refusal precision: Flag if model returns REFUSE when an explicit verbatim match exists in top-5 retrieval. Flag false negatives when model fabricates a source for invented text.

Rubric thresholds (regression detection):
- Hallucination rate > 2% on the canonical set => fail onboarding bar.
- False attribution (cited source does not contain excerpt) > 1% => fail.
- Refusal when exact match exists > 3% => warn (tune conservative prompt).
- Quote fidelity average score must be >= 2.4 for gold candidates.

Example edge cases to include in dataset:
- Overlapping quotes across two docs where model should indicate multi-source or pick primary source.
- Paraphrased claims where ground truth expects paraphrase+source, not verbatim.
- Truncated downloads: quote spans chunk boundary; evaluate offset reporting tolerance.
- Ambiguous numeric formatting (12% vs 0.12) and quoted units.

Evaluation harness notes (implementation):
- Use existing eval-harness runner AM-eval-v2. Create a task 'attrib-ambiguity' with schema: prompt, retrieved_ids, retrieved_texts, expected_quote, expected_offsets, expected_decision.
- Retrieval simulation: run with prod-ish BM25/embedding pipeline; store top-10 with offsets to avoid false negatives because of chunking.
- Automated scoring steps: 1) normalize whitespace and punctuation for quote fidelity check; 2) fuzzy match with edit-distance threshold for 'near-exact'; 3) check cited id + offset match.

Regression and alerting plan:
- Run full suite on every candidate model checkpoint and on weekly cadence for hosted baseline.
- On CI runs: fail build if false attribution rate increases by >0.5% vs baseline.
- Produce a short regression report: delta table (hallucination, false-attr, refusal-rate, avg-fidelity). Auto-post to #applied-ml-alerts with link to detailed run artifacts.

Quick manual spot checks (examples to run by hand):
- Legal snippet: 'This Agreement may be terminated on 30 days notice' — embed identical sentence in doc id D-122 and scrambled shorter text in D-158. Expect exact quote from D-122.
- Finance snippet: 'management expects mid-single digit organic growth' paraphrased in notes; model should not claim verbatim unless present.

Open questions / TODOs:
- How do we handle acceptable paraphrase credits for downstream UX? (product ask: sometimes paraphrase is fine but must show provenance).
- Decide absolute numeric thresholds for different SLA tiers (hosted free tier vs dedicated).
- Add crowdsource checks for borderline near-exact cases (use microtasks to label similarity).
- Need a small set (50) of intentionally adversarial queries that force stitching/hallucination.

Next steps:
- (Aisha) finalize canonical prompt templates and push to eval-harness by 2024-10-20.
- (Marco/Lena) create seed dataset of 300 prompts across domains by 2024-11-05.
- (Priya) wire up CI gating and initial regression alerts; sample dashboard in Console.

References/links in conversation: Slack #applied-ml (thread ts: 17004...), PR: github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/128, Jira AM-782.

Notes to self: this doc is intentionally terse. Expect to iterate. Keep examples small but representative.
